reviews.title: Stay away from Patreon
reviews.text:
At this point, I'd give negative stars if I could. I count on Patreon for my income, and used the platform for over ten years. Sure, they've had some issues in that time, but have always worked through the issues with me in a personable and interactive manner. 

But something has changed drastically. They suddenly and unilaterally deleted my account, denied my appeal, and any attempt to get any answers to my questions results in either (1) giving contradictory answers or (2) ignoring my questions entirely.

I depend on this income, I don't know what to do, they're not helping me, my backers are complaining, I don't have answers, and I may genuinely end up homeless. And this whole ordeal has been over a month long, at this point.

The way Patreon is handling this is so incompetent, it's unethical.

reviews.title: Please add these features and fix things FFS
reviews.text:
To start, I’m glad Patreon exists, I love the creators I follow but the UI is so so awful and there’s always issues with things not working like they’re supposed to. 

One of the biggest thing lacking is that you can’t create playlists to save videos. One of my main creators is an ASMRist and I listen to her videos every night to sleep but I’d rather create a playlist of my fave videos to return to every night, opposed to having to go through all her videos every night to find my favorites and queue them up. Not to mention the queue doesn’t always work for many reasons I’m not getting into. 

Another missing feature is a watch later list. I don’t know how this isn’t an obvious feature to have. Like I want to save specificvideos to watch later on without having to search for them. 

Watching a creator’s collection of videos using autoplay makes the videos go backwards from newest to oldest with no way to alter it, if I’m watching a reactor I’d like to go from ep 5 to ep 6 automatically and instead it goes to ep 4 if it’s on autoplay. What sense does that make?! Sometimes if it goes the right way somehow it’ll completely skip one and I’ll got from ep 5 to 7? 

There’s a lot of little issues like that. It should be easy to find the creators you follow without having to click open a side bar every time. I want my feed to be who I follow, not random people I don’t care about. Make a discover tab separately from the homepage if you want to have one. And add more customizable settin

reviews.title: Disrespects Its Users
reviews.text:
I’m quickly giving up on this app. The company has clearly shifted from presenting content of the people I support to trying to get me to see (and subscribe to) as many people as possible. 

Every time I open the app, it defaults to a Home tab that is showing creators I haven’t heard of and don’t want to engage with There’s no way to make the Membership tab, which shows only content of the creators I support, the default!

Every time I look at one of my creators’ posts, the app shows comments and first and then keeps scrolling to lots of unrelated “you may also like” posts. Except that I don’t care about any of this stuff, and it’s just trying to grab my attention in an unexpected and unsolicited manner.

This is hugely disrespectful to users of the app, it’s clearly intentional to serve the company rather than its creators & patrons, and it’ll have the opposite effect where I’ll stop using the platform and stop supporting people because Patreon, the company, has decided to prioritize their own profits and put users and creators second. I have zero hope that they’ll course-correct. Once Facebook went to an algorithmic timeline that didn’t prioritize users, they never went back. I doubt Patreon will do it, either - even though we’re paying the company (through the fees creators pay them from our contributions).

Hugely disappointing that we can’t even support a specific group of creators anymore without fighting algorithmic timelines.

reviews.title: App must be better in 2026
reviews.text:
I have been a 1+ year paid subscriber to two shows hosted on Patreon. I like the concept and premise of what Patreon says it is trying to do. But I’m no longer willing to endure a mobile app that provides a substandard viewing and navigation experience. I’m on an iPhone 17 and I can’t easily view in landscape mode, cannot switch between portrait and landscape viewing without having to completely exit out of the app, cannot find a way to customize the forward and back time intervals, cannot easily or consistently project or send the show from my mobile device to watch on a set top television, cannot switch seamlessly between show subscriptions. 

Seriously: all the cutesy, feel good, “we’re empowering creators” dialogue is worthless to me when I’m paying $250 per year to support creators and I’m relegated to experiencing their work through a mobile app that wouldn’t pass muster in 2010, much less in 2026. This isn’t a scrappy, underdog company anymore. So why does the mobile viewing experience still raggedy?

reviews.title: Patreon sides with scammers
reviews.text:
I’ve completely lost trust in Patreon after my most recent experience.

I subscribed to a creator’s higher-tier membership specifically because it advertised access to complete asset packs and commercial-use rights. After paying, I discovered that most of the promised downloads were inaccessible because the links had been removed. The only mention of these limitations was buried inside locked posts that were not visible before becoming a paying member. Even worse, discussions from other patrons experiencing the exact same issue were hidden inside the creator’s Discord server, which you only gain access to after subscribing.

I documented everything thoroughly: tier descriptions, missing downloads, moderator messages, reports from other patrons, and proof that I made repeated attempts to resolve the issue directly. A moderator even promised the missing content would be restored within 1–2 weeks, but nothing was ever delivered.

After all of that, Patreon still refused to issue a refund. Their response essentially boiled down to: “Refunds are entirely up to the creator.” So if a creator advertises rewards, fails to provide them, and refuses refunds, patrons are apparently just out of luck, even with substantial evidence.

That is an unbelievably patron-unfriendly system. Patreon loves to market itself as a platform supporting creators, but it seems to forget that patrons are the paying customers funding both the creators and Patreon itself. A platform that takes money from supp

Really not a fan of the direction this app is going in. It is now pushing hard on getting you to look at other totally unrelated creators. The unwanted push feels grossly similar to the torrential stream of content you get force fed by big social media platforms. Patreon was a respite from that. Seems like they're going for their commercial goals instead of the best user experience. The way they've implemented the push of other creators at you isn't even clever. It's just a dumping ground on your home screen. If you're going to push stuff I don't want,  at least try and lure me with some relevant instead of making it harder to do the main thing I want to do in the app (consume the content of people I follow). Disappointed.

Update: still not happy, but also noticed they app no longer has a place where you can manage your subscriptions from. For example, if I want to see who I’m paying money towards, there’s no central place for that. Why do the app creators keep making this app worse? 😬

reviews.title: POOR TECH SUPPORT
reviews.text:
This company has a very poor 2FA option that if you get disconnected from your authenticator app, you are totally screwed with these people. They do not respond to request for help and then they're just robbing you after that.

I was subscribed to multiple Patreon creators and paying a lot in a year and I'm going to have to go find which payment methods I used and put in a complaint to my banks to try to prevent Patreon from robbing me any further since they refuse to bother to respond to anything I write them. They must not have any technical support staff.

They have poorly designed the program so that if you get disconnected from the authenticator app when you restore your phone to factory settings during a phone problem or you replace your phone, you are stuck and can't get back in and these idiots running that place will not respond or say a word in response to a help message even though they claim to have people that will write you back after you put a support request in. 

But in fact nobody responds. They just sit there and take your money after that and they don't care that you're locked out and you've told them about it and they just ignore the problem.

That would be OK if it wasn't a paid account but it is and I won't stand for being robbed by these people. I doubt they will ever bother to read this because they are too lazy to have technical support so I couldn't imagine they're reading their reviews.

reviews.title: Can’t watch videos
reviews.text: Want to pay to get exclusive content and not be able to view it? Consider Patreon

reviews.title: So frustrated
reviews.text:
I was charged by Patreon on January 10th but never received access to the creator content. Even by January 19th, the issue wasn’t fixed.

Support kept asking me to provide an Apple-related number, but no number I gave was accepted. Instead of fixing the error, I was sent in the same support loop multiple times.

My bank refunded the charge due to lack of service, and now I can’t resubscribe because the issue was never resolved. I’m also not in my home country, which made this far more stressful than it should have been.

Patreon took the money, didn’t deliver access, and didn’t fix the problem. Very frustrating experience. Time and time again I provided screenshots, and proof of payment and lack of service. I asked for more in-depth directions and never received them. I’m at my wits end with this. Don’t use there services at this point

reviews.title: New layout is annoying
reviews.text: App works well. The Home Screen has recently been changed so that the home page is default and it shows you lots of creators you’d don’t follow on your home page. I’d rather just see the people I intentionally follow.

reviews.title: A royal pain in the butt to use
reviews.text: This app has seemed to design an automatic logout feature without any indication of when it’s going to be logged out. I have tried to open this app so many times and it was just met with a logon screen. I’m not fumbling through my passwords nor two factor authentication every time I want to use an app that I should be able to use at a moments notice. Therefore, it is barely functional/usable even if it has the greatest UI and back end of any social media app ever. This is frustrated me to my core so much that it has led me to leave this petty review.

reviews.title: Glitches and Navigation
reviews.text: Poorly designed UI and episodes continue to restart part ways through. This wasn’t a problem until recently.

reviews.title: Poor execution
reviews.text: User experience sucks. The app is for connecting with creators and community but it doesn’t send notifications most of the time, the notification page is very out of date and even though things have happened (posts, chats, reactions), it never updated when I refresh it. We can’t @ anyone so no one responds to chats because no one knows it’s happening. This app is 18 years old and functions like a university project that was forgotten about. For the amount of money you bring in, you should do MUCH better. Embarrassing.

reviews.title: The Worst App I Regularly Use
reviews.text: The new membership page is unintuitive and annoying to navigate. More clicks than before to get to individual memberships and the “membership” page does not let me separate subscriptions (I want to easily access a feed for just ONE creator at a time, you know, like before). I want to see the stuff I paid for, in a way that’s easy to navigate. Navigation choices are generally dumbfounding and now there’s a Home page with stuff I don’t care to see, instead of the things I pay money for. I understand this is generally unhelpful criticism, this app is consistently frustrating and poorly organized.

reviews.title: Unmatched in ruining their own UI
reviews.text:
A lot of companies these days get a lot of flak thrown their way for making pointless and stupid changes to things that worked perfectly fine already, but Patreon has taken that to new heights in 2025. First came quips, which made it so that your homepage is now 95% unsolicited garbage you didn’t ask to see, hope you like astrology and pyramid schemes, because that’s your homepage now.

What pushed me to write this review though is the newest update. The other day, Patreon inexplicably decided to remove the ability to select a specific creator you’re subscribed to, everything is now just smashed together into a single page labeled “my memberships”. If you have a lot of subscriptions, and a Patreon subscription that doesn’t post on a daily basis, that will now be permanently buried under your feed, and you will have no choice but to go use the search function.

It literally just added two extra steps to finding the membership page you wanted for absolutely no reason whatsoever.

reviews.title: Frustratingly Weird on IPad
reviews.text:
Two things about using this app on my iPad: 
1) I cannot see videos full screen — I get a message each time I try to choose the full screen option on the video that says that this feature is not supported on the app. 2) when I try to type a comment, the text box I’m using is covered by previous comments and I can’t see what I’m typing. I have to click out of my comment to get it to reappear. Then as soon as I start typing again the text box disappears again and I have to again click out of the box to get it to come back. If I spot an error I made earlier in my comment, when I try to put the cursor where I want to make the correction,  the correction appears at the end of my comment. To make a correction I have to delete all that I have written back to the point of the error and then type the rest all over again. 
My solution is that I don’t use the app at all anymore and have saved a link to the web version to my desktop.

reviews.title: Stop messing with the functions.
reviews.text: All of a sudden they’ve removed the ability to search for specific posts within a creator. Trying to go back and relisten to a specific old episode is almost impossible now.

reviews.title: Zero function
reviews.text: This app is now completely unresponsive on my app, like a still picture. I can’t interact with anything on screen. Nothing happens, zero function.

reviews.title: OK when it works
reviews.text: Today the app was totally unresponsive, no links working and the app had just updated. I'd tried all the usual checks (network, memory, battery, cache) and ended up performing an uninstall and reinstall. You'd think that the app developers would want to know about these issues but no..the support pages for iOS Patreon refer to a non-existent email link 'below' and the general support page email only offers categories that don't apply to outage or bug reports...everything but!

reviews.title: Frozen and Frozen
reviews.text: I'm not sure what this most recent update was but the app opens and then nothing. It is completely frozen. I deleted the app and reinstalled it. It worked until I went out of the app. When I went back in, frozen. So, I deleted it again.

reviews.title: Latest Update Won’t Allow Me To Make Posts
reviews.text: Newest update has made it so that I can’t upload or access posts at all. It shows I’m logged in but just gives me the loading screen of doom when I tap on anything. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Not connecting to YouTube
reviews.text: Not happy paying almost 20 a month and I can’t be involved in the chat because the video is no longer connecting to YouTube. !!!

reviews.title: Bloated homepage
reviews.text: My entire homepage is dedicated to random creators, who I have no clue about, any interest in and have not followed. It is so much, that I couldn’t even find a post from a creator who I have a PAID membership for because Patreon decided otherwise. Absolutely ridiculous. I’m a spiteful person, and this is making me consider dropping Patreon because it is such a stupid decision.

reviews.title: Annoying Algorithm Update
reviews.text: I wrote this months ago and apparently it never submitted because Apple is useless, but it’s still relevant cause Patreon js apparently just as useless. This app has consistently has issues with its UI and general user experience, but now apparently they’ve decided to add an algorithmic “trending” on the home page that advertising creators you don’t subscribe to and creating an entirely separate tab for your actual feed of followed creators. All of this opposed to just… you know, keeping the home page as a place for collective updated from the people you specifically paid money to follow. This is an incredibly needless and annoying addition to the app that makes me significantly regret my choice to update. If I am not following someone, I don’t want to see their posts in my feed, especially if I can’t actually see or interact with them in any real way beyond them clogging up my page, because, in case the creators of this platform forgot, you’re supposed to pay to see this stuff. I am so sick and tired of every app ever forcing unwanted algorithms into everything. If it’s not broken, don’t try to fix it. You only continue to make it worse.

reviews.title: Clunky, pushy.
reviews.text: So often this app just does its own thing, sort of responds to my inputs when it feels like it, or just does something else. Phew, it’s exhausting.

reviews.title: Update Has Ruined App
reviews.text: If I wanted to see random creators on my feed, I would be subscribed to them. Why would you ruin the home page with slop I don’t want to see? What an insult to your users
